description: Send USDC/USDT to a mutual friend. Pass username (@handle) when known, or name (first, last, or full name). Lookup is limited to mutual friends — never invent wallet addresses. If several friends match the name, the tool returns candidates; ask the owner which @username, then retry. Creates a pending pay — money does not move until Approve in Vybe. Trusted mutual friends still Approve once but notify quietly. Related: get_limits, get_spend_balance, get_wallet_balance, list_recent_pays.

inputSchema.description: Provide username and/or name plus amount. Prefer @username when known.

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string, for example 5 or 1.50.

memo.description: Optional short note shown on the Approve card.

name.description: First name, last name, or full name among mutual friends (e.g. Ada or Ada Lovelace). Used when username is omitted, or as an alternate hint.

token.description: Stablecoin to send. Defaults to usdc.

username.description: Recipient Vybe @username (with or without @), or a name string if name is omitted. Must resolve to a mutual friend.

inputSchema.title: SendToUserInput

name: send_to_user

outputSchema.description: Pending mutual-friend send, or ambiguous_recipient with candidates to disambiguate.
outputSchema.title: SendToUserResult

title: Send to mutual friend
